Strings.port_forwarding.title: Port Forwarding
Strings.port_forwarding.description: Create loopback-only SSH tunnels from this device to localhost services on the RemoteOS server. Active tunnels and SSH settings are never synchronized.
Strings.port_forwarding.ssh_note: Leave host empty to use the host in the current RemoteOS connection. Authentication is delegated to ssh and your existing key agent/configuration.
Strings.port_forwarding.fallback_note: If the requested local port is occupied, the next available loopback port is selected and returned below.
Strings.port_forwarding.editor_note: The target must be a loopback service on the RemoteOS server.
